import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({
    'name': ['Alice', 'Bob', 'Charlie', 'Diana', 'Eve'],
    'math_score': [85, 72, 91, 68, 95],
    'science_score': [78, 88, 82, 75, 90]
})

# Filter math > 80
high_math = df[df['math_score'] > 80]

# Add total column
high_math = high_math.copy()
high_math['total'] = high_math['math_score'] + high_math['science_score']

# Sort by total descending
result = high_math.sort_values('total', ascending=False)
print(result)
